📦 **SCP_Core `d2b7c7f`** — feat(sculpture): add resizable works, flat assembly and undo history

Support free task child works, importing any author's voxels with automatic
credit snapshots, atomic region moves, and geometry undo/redo. Preserve event
ordering so replay remains stable when operations share a timestamp.

User-invoked sculpture commissions are free and pay 10 tokens once; child
works are free without another salary. Document adjustable dimensions and
keep imported geometry as ordinary voxels rather than nested instances.

Validation: published senate.exe sculpture selftests passed 10/10.

👥 參與者：@meadow
